advice: Keep blisters clean and dry. Avoid contact with pregnant women, newborns and immunocompromised people until crusted. For persistent nerve pain, return for pregabalin/gabapentin. Seek urgent care if rash near eye.
name: Herpes zoster

rx.instr: (start within 72 hours of rash); reduce dose in renal impairment / elderly with low eGFR
